# smoke column sheet (generated by tools/gen_smoke_sheet_shots.py)
world smoke_sheet normal
size 960 540
timeout 1500
render 12
clouds off
waitchunks
wait 60
cmd skyabyss cinematic stop
cmd weather clear
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule doWeatherCycle false
cmd gamemode spectator
hud off
echo === spot 0 at 302 136
cmd time set 6000
cmd spreadplayers 302 136 0 1 false @s
waitchunks 400
wait 20

cmd execute if biome ~ ~ ~ #minecraft:is_mountain
cmd execute if biome ~ ~ ~ minecraft:plains
cmd execute positioned over motion_blocking_no_leaves run tp @s ~ ~1 ~ facing 132 125 136
cmd data get entity @s Pos
wait 30
